title: Project Aegis
description: Steal the proprietary neural network weighting files from the un-indexed data vault.

hints: The first part of the code is equal to the number of tomatoes in the dining room painting.
The third digit is the number of physical folding fans on display in Nathan's bedroom.
The fourth digit is similar to the third, but it instead counts those in the painting in the same room.

config.instruction: AI system access unlocked. Take the core weight files, or route the AI patent liquidation payout to your firm.
